criteria.observed: Three-ink harbour print with a striped sun, overprinted hills, town, pier, lighthouse, boat and waves above a Rozha One headline. But the sea was multiplied over the marigold sky, so it read as a dark green field.
criteria.repair: Removed the multiply blend from the sea so it prints as flat sea teal.

criteria.observed: Numbered tickets with dashed perforation, notches and marigold minute stubs; facts legible and unchanged.
Rozha One headlines and Bricolage Grotesque body text on cream, with indigo headers and terracotta buttons, across all four screens.
Dotted line with a ringed current stamp and hollow next stamps, but the phone capture landed about 34px short because smooth scrolling was still running.
criteria.repair: Smooth scrolling now applies only on wide screens with no reduced-motion preference.

criteria.observed: Warm, passionate copy throughout; walk facts unchanged.

rounds.summary: Tickets, type and voice met; the poster's sea colour and the phone scroll offset were repaired.

criteria.observed: The sea prints as teal water with cream waves; the hills still overprint the sky.
Consistent type and inks on all four screens.
The phone lands exactly on the walk screen; current and next stamps are clearly different. The visited state (filled ink stamp) cannot show in a capture taken at stop 1.
criteria.repair: Nothing to change in the build. The visited state is checked only in code, because the capture tool cannot press 'On to the next stop'.

criteria.observed: Copy warm and encouraging; facts unchanged.

rounds.summary: Four criteria met; the journey line is partly met only because the visited state cannot be captured.

audit: Every cited capture was opened with the read tool in this session; nothing outside this session confirms that.
